title: DBFlux redesign: NULL and modifier keywords in the keyword color (#987) · light
brief: Issue #987, accepted scope: NULL takes the keyword role in the SQL editor, the data grid and the row inspector, and the @attribute keywords (DESC, NULLS LAST, DEFAULT, COLLATE) take the keyword role in the editor. Before and after, real labels and palette values.

artboards.title: Before and after: editor, data grid and row inspector
artboards.tradeoff: Shows only the role change; the accent override and the string color proposal stay out, so the comparison isolates what this PR changes.
